intro: Halloween Saturday, markets closed, and KC still showed up: a two-word Stocktwits mic drop and a vote to leave the clocks alone once and for all. Low-key spooky, high-key iconic. 🎃🕰️

items.caption: Four words, two tickers, zero notes needed. KC on Halloween afternoon delivering the most efficient post on the platform, and the crowd showed up with the likes. 👻
With the clocks falling back this weekend, KC reposted a call to switch to standard time and then just leave the clocks alone forever. A man of the people (and of consistent sleep schedules). ⏰
